title: 2023 Panini #55 Taysom Hill New Orleans Saints Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2023 Panini Score card features Taysom Hill of the New Orleans Saints. The card is a standard size and is part of the base set. It is authenticated by Score and has not been autographed. The card number is 55 and it was manufactured by Panini. It is a NFL trading card and is perfect for any football fan or collector.
